Planning Document: docs/sepps/State Environmental Planning Policy (Primary Production) 2021 - NSW Legislation.pdf

Clause 2.1 - zoning (land_use_zoning): to facilitate the orderly economic use and development of lands for primary production

Clause 2.1 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): to reduce land use conflict and sterilisation of rural land by balancing primary production, residential development and the protection of native vegetation, biodiversity and water resources

Clause 2.1 - zoning (land_use_zoning): to identify State significant agricultural land for the purpose of ensuring the ongoing viability of agriculture on that land, having regard to social, economic and environmental considerations

Clause 2.1 - other (development_control): to simplify the regulatory process for smaller-scale low risk artificial waterbodies, and routine maintenance of artificial water supply or drainage, in irrigation areas and districts, and for routine and emergency work in irrigation areas and districts

Clause 2.1 - other (development_control): to encourage sustainable agriculture, including sustainable aquaculture

Clause 2.1 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): to require consideration of the effects of all proposed development in the State on oyster aquaculture

Clause 2.1 - other (development_control): to identify aquaculture that is to be treated as designated development using a well-defined and concise development assessment regime based on environment risks associated with site and operational factors.

Clause 2.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): aquaculture development means development for the purpose of aquaculture.
